posts.text:
This 15-minute AI agent workflow can help run parts of your business for you:

(even if you are non-technical)

1. Open ChatGPT.

2. Create a Project called “My AI Assistant.”

3. Upload:
 your FAQs
  services/products
  SOPs
  brand voice notes
  pricing sheet
  sales scripts

4. Tell ChatGPT:
 “You are my AI operations assistant.”

5. Add instructions like:
 answer customer questions
  write emails
  draft proposals
  organize ideas
  summarize meetings

OpenAI is ending its agreement to provide AI models to Cursor after SpaceX acquired the AI coding assistant. The service is expected to end on November 12, 2026. 
OpenAI said it cannot be certain that SpaceX will use its technology in accordance with the agreed terms.
